extracted.name: Shrimp Stock
extracted.description: Make this simple shrimp stock infused with shrimp shells, garlic, lemon, and aromatic vegetables as a base for gumbo, étouffée, or any other seafood dish.
ingredient_lines: shrimp shells from 2 pounds of shrimp, or to taste
0.25 cup celery leaves, or to taste
instruction_lines: Combine shrimp shells, onion, celery, celery leaves, lemon, garlic, peppercorns, thyme sprigs, and bay leaves in a saucepan. Pour in water and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Reduce the heat to low and simmer until reduced by half, skimming off foam as necessary, 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Strain and discard solids. Use immediately, or let cool to room temperature and refrigerate or freeze for later use.
